how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format printed with the notice.
Write the name of the post applied for clearly; send a separate application for each post.
Attach self-attested or gazetted-officer-attested certificates and mark sheets.
Send the application by registered post / speed post / courier to the Office of Women and Child Development Officer, in front of Collectorate, District Narayanpur (CG), by 18-11-2026, 5 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete, unclear or erroneous applications will be rejected without separate intimation No travel or other allowance for attending the skill test / walk-in interview No relaxation in essential qualification; minimum experience may be relaxed only in special cases with the Director's permission Selected candidate must give a notarised affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper about the marriage conditions Appointees are governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965

content_sections.heading: How Will District Women and Child Development Department, Narayanpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit list prepared on a marks system out of 80 marks Walk-in interview / skill test (20 marks) for candidates called in a 1:10 ratio Final selection list; appointment by the District Collector on the selection committee's recommendation Up to 60 marks on the percentage in the minimum educational qualification 02 marks per year of experience beyond the minimum, maximum 18 marks 02 bonus marks for Chhattisgarh domicile applicants; merit out of 80 marks Walk-in interview / skill test carries 20 marks; 10-10 marks when both are held Candidates called in a 1:10 ratio; tie broken by seniority in age

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 10th mark sheet/certificate for date of birth, 12th and graduation mark sheets/certificates Post graduation mark sheet if required for the post Caste certificate and domicile certificate Experience certificate from the employer, certified by a gazetted officer Identity proof (Aadhaar card / voter ID etc.) One self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 5 postage stamp

content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format printed with the notice. Write the name of the post applied for clearly; send a separate application for each post. Send the application by registered post / speed post / courier to the Office of Women and Child Development Officer, in front of Collectorate, District Narayanpur (CG), by 18-11-2026, 5 PM.

content_sections.text: Incomplete, unclear or erroneous applications will be rejected without separate intimation No travel or other allowance for attending the skill test / walk-in interview No relaxation in essential qualification; minimum experience may be relaxed only in special cases with the Director's permission Selected candidate must give a notarised affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper about the marriage conditions Appointees are governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Women and Child Development Department, Narayanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Women and Child Development Department, Narayanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Gender Specialist, 1 Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Women and Child Development Department, Narayanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format printed on pages 6-7 of the notice) and send it to Office of Women and Child Development Officer, Women and Child Development Department, in front of Collectorate, District Narayanpur (Chhattisgarh), by registered post / speed post / courier, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Gender Specialist: 21 to 45 years; Office Assistant: 21 to 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 25780.00 (Level 8) for Gender Specialist, 18420.00 (Level 6) for Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Gender Specialist: graduate degree in social work or other social fields, 3 years of gender-related work and 3 years of women's issues experience. Office Assistant: graduation or diploma in accounts or another field with accounts as one subject, and 3 years of accounts work in government or semi-government institutions. Computer knowledge with MS Office and typing is essential for both posts. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Good computer knowledge with MS Office and computer typing essential for both posts. Office Assistant must be a domicile (mool niwasi) of Chhattisgarh, with a residence certificate from the competent authority. Gender Specialist: Chhattisgarh residence not mandatory; Chhattisgarh local residents get preference and 02 bonus marks. Government/semi-government employees must apply with their employer's No Objection Certificate.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidate who married before the minimum legal age of marriage. Candidate who married a person whose husband/wife is already living (the government may exempt for sufficient reason). Candidate convicted of any crime against women.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared on a marks system out of 80 marks. Walk-in interview / skill test (20 marks) for candidates called in a 1:10 ratio. Final selection list; appointment by the District Collector on the selection committee's recommendation. Up to 60 marks on the percentage in the minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract / lump-sum pay for a maximum of 02 years initially. Term may be extended by the District Collector by 01 year each time based on performance and need. Appointment purely temporary; either party may end it with one month's notice or one month's pay.
